scholarships.name: Schulich Leader Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen or permanent resident. Graduating high school or CEGEP in current year. Enrolling in STEM program at one of 20 partner universities. Entrepreneurial-minded with leadership, charisma, creativity. Must be nominated by high school. Strong consideration for financial need.

scholarships.name: Loran Award
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen or permanent resident. Graduating high school or CEGEP. Demonstrated character, service, and leadership. Selected through multi-round process including interviews. Approximately 36 recipients per year from 6,000+ applicants.

scholarships.name: Terry Fox Humanitarian Award
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen or landed immigrant. Completed community humanitarian service. Demonstrates courage and determination by overcoming adversity. Pursuing first post-secondary degree or diploma. Approximately 20 recipients per year.

scholarships.name: TD Scholarship for Community Leadership
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen or permanent resident. Final year of high school (or CEGEP in Quebec). Minimum 75% average (or R-score 26 in Quebec). Demonstrated community leadership. Up to 25 scholarships awarded annually.

scholarships.name: McCall MacBain Scholarships (McGill)
scholarships.criteria: Applying to a graduate program at McGill University. Demonstrated character, community engagement, leadership, entrepreneurial spirit, academic strength, and intellectual curiosity. Open to applicants worldwide. Covers full tuition plus living stipend.

scholarships.name: Horatio Alger Canadian Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen or permanent resident. Enrolled full-time as a Grade 11 student. Commitment to pursue bachelor's degree. Critical financial need (family income $80,000 or less). Involvement in co-curricular and community service. Integrity and perseverance in overcoming adversity.

scholarships.name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship (U of T)
scholarships.criteria: International students nominated by their high school. Exceptional academic achievement and creativity. Recognition as a leader within their school. Attending University of Toronto. Covers tuition, books, incidental fees, and full residence for 4 years.

scholarships.name: RBC Elevate Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen, permanent resident, or protected person. Pursuing first bachelor's degree or diploma. 40 scholarships awarded annually. Valued up to $15,000.

scholarships.name: RBC Ignite Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen, permanent resident, or protected person/convention refugee. 500 scholarships awarded annually. For students entering or continuing post-secondary education.

scholarships.name: RBC Reimagine Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen, permanent resident, or protected person. Seeking upskilling or reskilling opportunities. 100 scholarships awarded annually.

scholarships.name: RBC Future Launch Scholarship for Black Youth
scholarships.criteria: Identify as Black Canadian citizen, permanent resident, or refugee. High school student entering Grade 11 or 12, or enrolled in post-secondary. 20 scholarships awarded annually.

scholarships.name: RBC Future Launch Scholarship for Indigenous Youth
scholarships.criteria: First Nations, Inuit, or Métis student. Canadian citizen or permanent resident. Demonstrating strong academic performance and community involvement. 20 scholarships awarded annually.

scholarships.name: RBC Capital Markets Diversity Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: BIPOC student in Canada. Pursuing post-secondary education. Up to 8 scholarships awarded. Includes summer job, mentorship, and coaching.

scholarships.name: BMO Diversity Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: High school, university, or college student in Canada. Available in every field of study. Specific scholarships for Indigenous students and students with disabilities.

scholarships.name: CIBC Student Life Network Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: High school student 16 years of age or older in Canada. Contest format. Open February to June annually.

scholarships.name: Telesat Women in Engineering & Technology Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen or permanent resident. Enrolled or accepted in an engineering or technology program at a recognized Canadian post-secondary institution. Identifies as a woman. Indigenous, visible minority, and students with disabilities strongly encouraged to apply. 10 scholarships awarded.

scholarships.name: Alberta Women in STEM Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Identify as a woman. Pursuing career in STEM field where gender is underrepresented. Enrolled in eligible Alberta post-secondary institution. Application opens September 2026.

scholarships.name: Canadian Women in STEM Scholarship (FIRST Robotics Canada)
scholarships.criteria: Young women currently or recently enrolled in Canadian high school. Participated on a FIRST Robotics team. Planning to attend a post-secondary STEM program in Canada.

scholarships.name: FIRST Canada Skilled Trade Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Participated on a FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC) or FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) team. Pursuing higher education or career in a skilled trade.

scholarships.name: De Beers Group Women in STEM Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Identifies as a woman. Entering Year 1 of a STEM or STEM-related baccalaureate program at a recognized Canadian post-secondary institution. Renewable scholarship.

scholarships.name: SCWIST Scholarships (Society for Canadian Women in Science and Technology)
scholarships.criteria: Women pursuing STEM education in Canada. Multiple awards available through SCWIST for different STEM fields and education levels.

scholarships.name: Indspire Building Brighter Futures Bursaries & Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: First Nations, Inuit, or Métis student. Enrolled or accepted at a Canadian post-secondary institution. One application covers all Indspire bursaries and scholarships. Over $280 million disbursed since 1996. Applications open May 1 annually.

scholarships.name: Alberta First Nations, Métis and Inuit Bursary
scholarships.criteria: Self-identify as First Nations, Métis, or Inuit. Enrolled in bachelor's, master's, or PhD program at an Alberta post-secondary institution. Up to 4 years of funding.

scholarships.name: National Indigenous Scholarship Program (Western University)
scholarships.criteria: Indigenous student (First Nations, Métis, or Inuit). Applying to Western University. Based on academic achievement and community involvement.

scholarships.name: University of Waterloo Scholarships for Black Students
scholarships.criteria: Students of African, African American, Afro-Latine, Black Canadian, Caribbean, or other African descent. Applying to study at University of Waterloo in 2026.

scholarships.name: Jean Lumb Awards
scholarships.criteria: Canadian student. Open to various backgrounds. No essay required. Recognizes achievement in areas from arts to community service.

scholarships.name: LOUD Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: Grade 12 or university student in Canada. Member of the 2SLGBTQ+ community. Demonstrating leadership in the community. Approximately 20 awards per year. Applications open November, close January 31.

scholarships.name: Bill 7 Award Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Ontario resident. Identify as lesbian, gay, bisexual, trans, two-spirited, or queer. Financial need. Enrolled in first program of study at any Ontario post-secondary institution. 16–20 scholarships awarded annually.

scholarships.name: Lambda Foundation Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: 2SLGBTQ+ student in Canada. Pursuing post-secondary education. Various awards available through the foundation.

scholarships.name: Jeremy Dias Scholarship (Canadian Centre for Gender & Sexual Diversity)
scholarships.criteria: Youth across Canada who have taken initiative in addressing discrimination in their school or community. 2SLGBTQ+ ally or community member.

scholarships.name: Rick & Amanda Hansen Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Youth with a physical disability. Pursuing 1- to 5-year post-secondary program at a publicly funded Canadian institution. Up to $10,000/year for up to 4 years.

scholarships.name: Canada Student Grant for Students with Permanent Disabilities
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen or permanent resident. Enrolled at a designated post-secondary institution. Documented permanent disability. Federal government grant.

scholarships.name: DCCI Scholarship for Canadian Students with Disabilities
scholarships.criteria: High school student with documented disability. Pursuing post-secondary education in health care, criminal justice, or community & social services at an accredited Canadian institution. Annual scholarship.

scholarships.name: CNIB Scholarships (Canadian National Institute for the Blind)
scholarships.criteria: Student who is blind or partially sighted. Enrolled or accepted at a Canadian post-secondary institution. Over 10 different scholarships available.

scholarships.name: RISE Scholarship (Beedie Luminaries)
scholarships.criteria: Refugee granted permanent residency or protected person status after Jan 1, 2016. Residing full-time in British Columbia for previous 6 months. Pursuing post-secondary education. Full-time or part-time study.

scholarships.name: Daniel Schickedanz Scholarship (Canadian Council for Refugees)
scholarships.criteria: Young person of refugee and/or migrant background. Pursuing higher education in Canada. Community engagement. 10 scholarships per year.

scholarships.name: BC Provincial Scholarships Program
scholarships.criteria: Grade 12 student completing high school in British Columbia. Supports post-secondary tuition and fees. Multiple awards available through the provincial program.

scholarships.name: Owen Hart Foundation Award
scholarships.criteria: High school senior attending a Calgary-area school. Community involvement and academic achievement.

scholarships.name: Clay Riddell Community Hero Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Canadian youth who demonstrate community involvement and exemplify leadership, integrity, and generosity. Up to 3 awards per year.

scholarships.name: UBC International Major Entrance Scholarship (IMES)
scholarships.criteria: International student admitted to UBC. Exceptional academic achievement, leadership, and community involvement. Automatically considered upon admission. Renewable.

scholarships.name: UBC Schulich Leader Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Canadian citizen. Nominated by high school. Enrolling in STEM program at UBC. Entrepreneurial-minded with leadership qualities.

scholarships.name: McGill Entrance Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: Admitted to McGill University. Based on academic achievement. Automatic consideration upon admission for most entrance scholarships. Major entrance scholarships require separate application.

scholarships.name: University of Waterloo Entrance Awards
scholarships.criteria: Admitted to University of Waterloo. Based on admission average. Multiple tiers available. International students may receive automatic $10,000 first-year funding.

scholarships.name: Queen's University Major Admission Awards
scholarships.criteria: Admitted to Queen's University. Automatic $4,000 award based on admission average. Major admission awards require separate application emphasizing community involvement and creative thinking.

scholarships.name: McMaster Provost Entrance Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.criteria: International student admitted to McMaster University. Based on academic excellence. Automatically considered.

scholarships.name: University of Alberta Entrance Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: Admitted to University of Alberta. Based on academic achievement. WISEST scholarships available for women in STEM. Automatic and application-based awards.

scholarships.name: Dalhousie University Entrance Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: Admitted to Dalhousie University. Based on academic excellence. Schulich Leader Scholarships also available through Dal. Automatic and application-based.

scholarships.name: U Sports Athletic Financial Awards (AFA)
scholarships.criteria: Student-athlete at a U Sports member university. Meeting minimum academic requirements. Award value capped at tuition and compulsory fees. Available across all U Sports member institutions.

scholarships.name: CCAA Athletic Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: Student-athlete at a Canadian Collegiate Athletic Association member college. Meeting academic eligibility requirements. Over $7 million awarded annually across CCAA members.

scholarships.name: Athlete Assistance Program (AAP) — Government of Canada
scholarships.criteria: High-performance Canadian athlete. Carded by a national sport organization. Assists athletes combining sport and academic/working careers while training for international competition.

scholarships.name: Study in Canada Scholarships (Government of Canada)
scholarships.criteria: International students from select countries in Asia, Europe, Middle East, North Africa, and Sub-Saharan Africa. For study at eligible Canadian post-secondary institutions. Fully funded including tuition, travel, and living expenses.

scholarships.name: Vanier Canada Graduate Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: Doctoral student at a Canadian institution. Nominated by the institution. Demonstrated leadership, academic excellence, and research potential. Health, natural sciences/engineering, or social sciences/humanities. Note: program transitioning to CGRS-D.

scholarships.name: Canada Graduate Research Scholarship — Doctoral (CGRS-D)
scholarships.criteria: Doctoral student at a Canadian institution. Administered by CIHR, NSERC, and SSHRC. Research excellence in health, natural sciences/engineering, or social sciences/humanities.

scholarships.name: Pierre Elliott Trudeau Foundation Doctoral Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Doctoral student. Covers tuition and living expenses plus research/travel/networking costs. Highly competitive. Annual competition closes ~November.

scholarships.name: Skilled Trades College Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Student pursuing skilled trades education at an accredited Canadian trades college. Various programs supported including electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and welding.

scholarships.name: Scotiabank Women for STEM Scholarship (Ontario Tech University)
scholarships.criteria: Female student enrolled in a STEM program at Ontario Tech University. Financial need considered. Supports women pursuing STEM careers.

scholarships.name: MPOWER Women in STEM Scholarship (Canada)
scholarships.criteria: Female international or DACA student. Currently enrolled or accepted in full-time STEM degree program. Must study at an MPOWER-eligible program in Canada or United States.

scholarships.name: Mavis Smith Scholarship for Afro-Caribbean Students (Concordia)
scholarships.criteria: Afro-Caribbean student currently pursuing Bachelor's degree at Concordia University in any discipline. Addresses underrepresentation of Black students in academia.

scholarships.name: University of Waterloo Women in Engineering Entrance Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Female student admitted to an engineering program at University of Waterloo. Based on academic achievement and leadership.

scholarships.name: Leaders To Be Proud Of Awards (Start Proud)
scholarships.criteria: 2SLGBTQ+ student in Canada. Demonstrated leadership and professional development. Transitioning from school to career.

scholarships.name: Chown Centennial Scholarship
scholarships.criteria: Available to all high schools in Manitoba and Northwestern Ontario. $1,000 per student.

scholarships.name: Canadian Hearing Society Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: Student who is Deaf, deafblind, or hard of hearing. Enrolled at a Canadian post-secondary institution. 20 scholarships awarded annually.

scholarships.name: University of Ottawa Entrance Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: Admitted to University of Ottawa. Based on admission average. Automatic and application-based awards available. Various tiers for domestic and international students.

scholarships.name: UNB (University of New Brunswick) Entrance Scholarships
scholarships.criteria: High school student admitted to University of New Brunswick. Based on academic achievement. Multiple tiers and application-based awards.

scholarships.name: OFSAA Scholarships (Ontario Federation of School Athletic Associations)
scholarships.criteria: Ontario high school student-athlete. Demonstrated athletic and academic excellence. Must be nominated through OFSAA member school.
